  const api=ArgusTemplate, node=(tag,content,className) => {const element=document.createElement(tag);if(content!==undefined)element.textContent=String(content ?? '—');if(className)element.className=className;return element;};

    changes(root,data){const rows=Array.isArray(data.preview?.changes)?data.preview.changes:data.diff||[];const fields=rows.filter(row=>row.path||row.field),steps=rows.filter(row=>!row.path&&!row.field);if(fields.length)view.table(root,fields,[[view.text('字段 / 路径','Field / path'),row=>row.path||row.field],[view.text('变更前','Before'),'before'],[view.text('变更后','After'),'after']]);for(const row of steps)view.note(root,row.text||view.value(row));if(!rows.length)view.note(root,view.text('未提供字段差异；请查看目标与影响。','Field differences unavailable; see target and impact.'));},

<script>
(() => {

 };
